validate:

  next: postcode

# Validate the optional postcode WHEN PRESENT (4 digits, and within the city region's range for a

postcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequirePostcode
  next: uniqueIdentity

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.

## Summary

Added a soft-duplicate ("possibleDuplicate") flag to `POST /api/owners`: when a newly created owner isn't a hard identity duplicate but shares an existing owner's `lastName` and `postcode` with a *different* telephone, it's still created and now records `possibleDuplicate: true` and `possibleDuplicateOf: <matching owner id>`; otherwise `possibleDuplicate: false`.

Following the existing OfficeFloor function-injection conventions in the repo (mirroring the `AssignNamesakeCount`/`AssignHouseholdSize` "assigned at creation" pattern):

1. **New function** `AssignPossibleDuplicate.java` — scans existing owners for one sharing the normalized `lastName` + `postcode` but with a different E.164-normalized telephone (skipping self, since it runs before `SaveOwner`), picks the earliest (lowest-id) match, and sets the two fields. An owner with no postcode never soft-matches.

2. **Pipeline wiring** — inserted `assignPossibleDuplicate` (with `govern: [ transaction ]`) between `assignBulkWarning` and `save` in `owners.POST.yml`.

3. **Owner model** — added persisted `possibleDuplicate` (`Boolean`) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (`Integer`) columns with getters/setters, so `GET /api/owners/{id}` reads them back.

4. **OpenAPI schema** — added `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf` (readOnly) to the `Owner` schema, which regenerates `OwnerDto` and auto-maps via MapStruct.

5. **DB schema** — added `possible_duplicate` / `possible_duplicate_of` columns to all four dialects (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres), placed at the end of the table so positional seed inserts stay aligned, and appended the two trailing `NULL`s to the hsqldb positional owner inserts (the only dialect using positional inserts).

The acceptance test `coreFlagsPossibleDuplicate` and the full suite pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`).
